source: ESPN pro-team schedules · ESPN actual PPR statistics (4-point passing TD) · PFR snap counts via nflverse (2310 matched player games) · nflverse injury reports (566 matched reports) · nflverse play-by-play red-zone usage (766 matched player weeks)

methodology.scoring: Full PPR, 4-point passing TD, regular season only
methodology.redZone: Carries plus targets on non-nullified plays at or inside the 20
methodology.inside10: Carries plus receptions at or inside the 10; kneeldowns excluded
methodology.routes: Not imputed from snaps. Display only when a route-count source is supplied.
methodology.injuries: Only explicitly Out reports establish an out cohort; other missing statistics are not injuries.
